phase: Authenticated single-host lease and zero-provider dispatch foundation
response_visibility: Only the authenticated principal's requested lease/action/receipt. Every receipt binds run_id and config_sha256. No global task/candidate/inbox/accounting listings.
identity: Distinct per-principal HMAC keys; exact request bytes and run/config binding; principal-scoped request/action IDs; service-derived common reservation namespace

fixtures.text_build: Return uppercase supplied text and its UTF-8 SHA256
fixtures.text_review: Hash supplied text and approve iff nonempty and uppercase
fixtures.source_binding: Recompute exact text SHA256 and canonical request digest; context event IDs remain caller assertions for separate local-visibility audit
fixtures.usage: Always zero provider usage; trusted completion refunds generic test reservation credits

atomicity: Frozen Ledger mutations join the same SQLite transaction as request journal; savepoint rolls back rejected mutations; initial dispatch reserve+intent commit precedes fixed fixture; result+trusted settlement commit together
ambiguity: Unresolved durable intent becomes unknown on restart, retains full reservation and fences task reclaim/further dispatch; no automatic invocation replay or peer-controlled resolution
entry_trace: Private durable authority_invocations row before fixed fixture entry; entry-attempt evidence only, not completed execution or provider calls
time: Authority samples wall clock after write-lock acquisition and persists max(previous,current); backward clock movement may delay real-time lease expiry
ownership: Exclusive local flock; close rejects new handlers and waits for active handlers before releasing ownership
remaining: Real provider and independent accounting adapter
